MODBUS MAP node = server 1, holding registers, 19 200 8N1; -32768 = no reading
Command: 1 send IR now, 2 reset alarms
Flags 0x0F: b0 AC on (commanded), b1 eco, b2 shutdown request, b3 lower door open, b4 water,
b5 AC socket live, b6 compressor running, b7 compressor state known, b8 mains detect fitted.
